card.answer_text: Insufficient evidence: confidence is below the publication threshold.
card.next_step: Change areas are the least reliable number SatClip measures. Check the water extent on each date instead (buttons below); each is measured and calibrated on its own.
card.method: Sentinel-1 same-orbit pair: VV and VH water thresholds fitted on the after scene, plus a 3 dB backscatter drop in either
selection_notes: monsoon month, so radar is used first because it sees through cloud
same ascending orbit and track (41) as the after scene
caveats: Change compares two passes on the same orbit; it shows where water appeared, not why.
Wind-roughened water and wet soil can hide or mimic change.
